outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: The Algoma Central was the first Canadian railway to fully dieselize, in 1952.

outgoing.name: Lake Superior
outgoing.excerpt: Marie to a junction with the Canadian Pacific Railway's main line, as well as a branch line to Michipicoten Harbour, on Lake Superior near Wawa.

outgoing.name: Mining
outgoing.excerpt: Starting around the 1960s, the railway greatly expanded its marine operations and diversified into trucking, real estate, forestry, and mining operations.

outgoing.name: North America
outgoing.excerpt: …Algoma Central would run the longest passenger trains in North America, often up to 20 to 24 cars long.
